diagrams.process:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Current["Current workflow"]
        C1[Change the assistant] --> C2[Read a few answers by eye]
        C2 --> C3[Ship on judgement]
        C3 --> C4[Failures found by agents and customers]
        C4 --> C5[Fix the reported case]
        C5 --> C1
    end
    subgraph Proposed["Proposed workflow"]
        P1[Change the assistant] --> P2[Run harness on golden set]
        P2 --> P3[Label failures by class]
        P3 --> P4[Budgeted judge pass, capped]
        P4 --> P5{Regression gate at 0.900}
        P5 -->|blocked| P7[Fix by failure class]
        P7 --> P2
        P5 -->|passed| P6[Dashboard review and ship]
        P6 --> P8[Commit result files as the record]
        P8 --> P1
    end
diagrams.architecture:
flowchart LR
    GS[Golden set: questions and gold answers] --> PT[Pipeline under test]
    CORP[Corpus snapshot] --> PT
    PT --> ANS[Answers with retrieved passages]
    ANS --> LM[Lexical metrics]
    ANS --> BJ[Budgeted judge layer]
    BJ --> EJ[Embedding judge]
    LM --> RES[Per-case results: scores and failure labels]
    EJ --> RES
    RES --> GATE{Regression gate at 0.900}
    GATE -->|pass| REL[Release decision: ship]
    GATE -->|fail| BLOCK[Release blocked, fix by failure class]
    RES --> DASH[Dashboard: aggregates and per-case drill-down]
    RES --> REP[reproduce.sh: byte-drift check in CI]
